title: Samsung launches One UI 9 rollout in Brazil
seoTitle: Samsung launches One UI 9 rollout in Brazil
subtitle: The new interface, based on Android 17, arrives with a focus on artificial intelligence and performance improvements.
excerpt: Samsung released One UI 9 for Galaxy smartphones in Brazil on Tuesday (29). The update, built on Android 17, focuses on artificial intelligence and performance.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Brazilian Samsung smartphone users started receiving the long‑awaited One UI 9 update on Tuesday (29). The new version, which promises AI‑driven improvements and features for Galaxy devices, sparked a surge of searches and interest regarding its availability and capabilities.

What is One UI 9 and why it’s generating buzz

One UI 9 is Samsung’s latest user interface, built on Android 17, the newest operating system. Launched globally on September 16, the update took about 13 days to reach users in Brazil. Its arrival on Tuesday (29) caused a spike in queries and celebration among Samsung device owners.

First devices to receive the update

Initially, the One UI 9 update is being rolled out to the Galaxy S26 series, which includes the Galaxy S26, S26+, and S26 Ultra. It’s worth noting that the recently launched Galaxy S26 FE already ships with One UI 9 out of the box, making it the first S‑series model to debut with Android 17.

Main new features and artificial intelligence

One UI 9 does not bring major visual overhauls, but focuses on overall performance, stability, and the introduction of new artificial‑intelligence features that are part of the Galaxy AI suite. Samsung describes One UI 9 as "bringing Galaxy AI closer to your daily life with more useful and intuitive experiences," enabling "new ways to simplify tasks, create, and stay connected with AI functions that adapt to how you use your Galaxy."

Key AI functionalities include:

  • My FanCam: An intelligent editing tool that lets you "track" a person in a video and adjust the frame ratio with just a few taps.
  • Now Nudge: A more proactive assistant that suggests actions based on the content displayed on the screen, such as scheduling events or creating reminders.

The full update is around 4 GB, so downloading over Wi‑Fi is recommended to avoid consuming mobile data.

How to check and install One UI 9

To see if One UI 9 is available for your Samsung smartphone, follow these simple steps:

  1. Open the "Settings" app.
  2. Scroll to the bottom and tap "Software update."
  3. Tap "Download and install."

After these steps, wait for the verification process and, if the update is available, start the download and installation.

Upcoming rollout for other Galaxy models

Samsung says that in the coming days and weeks, One UI 9 will be released to a broader range of devices. Models from earlier lines—such as the Galaxy S23 through S25, the Z Fold 5 to Z Fold 7 series, and mid‑range Galaxy A devices—are on the list. Additional devices like the Galaxy Z Flip 7, the Galaxy S24 line, Galaxy Z Flip 6, Galaxy Z Fold 6, and Galaxy A57 are also expected to receive the update in the coming weeks, extending the new features to an even larger user base.

Information sourced from Estadão and Tecnoblog.
